subject: Windows reins in AI agents 🖥️, Optimizely spreads malware 🚨, Snowflake opens data sharing ❄️

stories.headline: SAP completes acquisition of TechWolf; it joins the SAP SuccessFactors portfolio
stories.quote: TechWolf will become part of the SAP SuccessFactors portfolio to support talent and work intelligence strategies.
stories.description: Talent and work intelligence; joining the SAP SuccessFactors portfolio

facts.text: The issue's item title says SAP has completed the acquisition of TechWolf.

stories.headline: Microsoft announces new Windows controls for AI agents, including process containers and micro VMs
stories.quote: Microsoft announced new Windows controls for AI agents, including preview improvements to process containers and experimental hardware-isolated micro VMs.

facts.text: Learning modes are generally available; Intune is previewing automatic updates for employee-installed applications.
facts.quote: Generally available learning modes let IT observe agent behavior before enforcing restrictions, while Intune is previewing automatic updates for applications employees install themselves.

stories.headline: Attackers used Optimizely's experimentation software to spread malicious JavaScript to at least 178 organizations' websites
stories.quote: Attackers exploited Optimizely's experimentation software to distribute malicious JavaScript through websites belonging to at least 178 organizations.

facts.text: The payloads targeted cryptocurrency wallets and payment details.
facts.quote: The payloads targeted cryptocurrency wallets and payment details.

facts.text: Optimizely says it patched the vulnerability, removed the injected code and revoked tokens.
facts.quote: Optimizely says it patched the vulnerability, removed injected code, and revoked tokens.

stories.headline: Microsoft and Salesforce announce integrations connecting Salesforce with Copilot, Teams and Fabric
stories.quote: Microsoft and Salesforce announced integrations connecting Salesforce with Copilot, Teams, and Fabric.

facts.text: A Copilot plugin is in public preview with more than 38 sales skills.
facts.quote: A Copilot plugin is available in public preview with more than 38 sales skills, letting employees retrieve customer information and take supported actions under their existing Salesforce permissions.

stories.headline: Microsoft adds impersonation and social-engineering protections to Teams meetings and calls
stories.quote: Microsoft is introducing new capabilities to combat social engineering and impersonation across Teams meetings and calls.

stories.headline: Snowflake launches Open Data Sharing for Apache Iceberg tables, usable without a Snowflake account
stories.quote: Snowflake has launched Open Data Sharing, enabling data providers to share Apache Iceberg tables with external consumers using Iceberg REST Catalog-compatible clients without requiring a Snowflake account or scheduled data exports.
